registrationPacket.termsTitle: Student Undertaking for Continuity of Attendance and Education
registrationPacket.termsSubtitle: Please review and observe the following points carefully
termsItems: The student must attend at the time specified by administration, whether in person or online according to Iranian education decisions, and must join the morning line-up and opening activities before class while observing the full school uniform.
Attendance times must be strictly observed. Any delay or absence must be reported to the school immediately, and extended absence may trigger action according to the school committee.
The student must observe ethics, discipline, public manners, and the full official school uniform inside the campus.
The student is responsible for preserving books, classroom furniture, and other school facilities.
Responsibility for bringing valuable or unnecessary items and excessive cash rests with the student and family, and the guardian should warn the student accordingly.
Mobile phones and personal cameras are strictly prohibited without prior school approval for all grades, and violations may result in confiscation until the end of the school year.
Public manners and social ethics must be respected; otherwise the student bears the consequences under school rules.
The student must leave the school within 15 minutes after the official end of the day; beyond that the school holds no responsibility.
Transportation and certificate authentication are the responsibility of guardians.
Tuition does not include the uniform, textbooks, or trips.
Accessories, jewelry, and cosmetics are not allowed during the school day.
Daily homework and regular monthly assessments must be followed by the guardian.
Tuition is calculated in full regardless of the length of the student’s attendance.
The guardian commits to attending parent meetings regularly and as required.
If the student exceeds 25% absence from actual school days, the student will be treated as an external candidate and may only attend exams; study responsibility remains with the guardian.
At least 50% of tuition must be paid before the first term begins and the remainder before the second term. If fees are not paid on time, the school may restrict class or exam access.
School committee decisions must be implemented.
